evidence: Aluminum nitride (AlN) thin films have attracted significant attention in optoelectronics 1 and micro-electro-mechanic system (MEMS) applications, for example, energy harvesting, 2–4 and surface-acoustic-wave transducers and resonators, 2,4 due to their excellent properties such as a wide direct bandgap of 6.2 eV, piezoelectricity along the c-axis, high phase velocities, and high thermal stability.2
